description: This file defines a PHP class 'Coupon' within the Opencart admin module, specifically under the Marketing namespace. The class provides various methods to manage marketing coupons, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving coupons, as well as managing related entities such as products, categories, and histories.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Model class for managing marketing coupons within the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addCoupon
methods.description: Creates a new coupon entry with provided data, returning the coupon ID.

methods.name: editCoupon
methods.description: Updates an existing coupon identified by coupon_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteCoupon
methods.description: Deletes a coupon by coupon_id along with associated products, categories, and histories.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves details of a coupon by coupon_id.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Fetches a coupon's details using its unique code.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Returns a list of coupons, optionally sorted and paginated, based on provided filter data.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total count of coupons in the database.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves coupon usage histories, with pagination support.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records related to a specific coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns total number of history entries for a given coupon.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes all product associations for a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProductsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes all associations of a specific product ID from coupons.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Associates a category with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategories
methods.description: Deletes all category associations for a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Deletes all associations of a specific category ID from coupons.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories associated with a coupon.

methods.name: getCouponCategories
methods.description: Alias or method to get categories of a coupon.
